title: finance.search
description: Search the node's tracked universe by ticker symbol or company name (case-insensitive substring; symbol-prefix matches rank first). Catalog-only — no upstream fetch. Returns { query, matches: [{ symbol, name, sector }], count }. Used by the app's search box and the stock_search voice tool to resolve a spoken company name to a ticker.

query.description: Search text — a ticker fragment ('NV') or a company name fragment ('lockheed').
